run_InferenceBenchRunner: run the InferenceBenchRunner to benchmark MLIP model inference speed across multiple model checkpoints and atom counts
create_CompileDebugSettings: create a CompileDebugSettings dataclass to configure torch.compile graph break logging and dynamo explain debugging
benchmark_get_qps: benchmark a predictor model using get_qps to measure queries per second and structures per day throughput
profile_make_profile: profile a predictor model using make_profile to generate CPU and CUDA Chrome traces for performance analysis
debug_run_dynamo_explain: debug torch.compile graph breaks using _run_dynamo_explain to analyze model compilation issues and break reasons
